core_obligations: Uniqueness: properties (1) and (2) force U = U(psi), r on points via the standard-open basis and sobriety, and theta via the graded ring maps A_f to the sections of the twists.

Existence: by uniqueness it suffices to work where T is affine, L trivial and some psi(f) is a unit; there theta extends the graded map A to R[x] by inverting f, and theta in degree zero gives the ring map A_(f) to R, hence r.
Last statement: on a locus where psi(A_d) generates L^{tensor d}, the pair of the converse-construction lemma is unique, and restrictions of the diagram identify r and theta with that pair.
proof_roadmap: Prove uniqueness from the basis of standard opens and the graded identification, construct the pair on affine trivializing pieces, glue by uniqueness, then read off the final agreement.
difficulty_reason: Uniqueness by sober-space comparison plus a graded localization computation, existence by affine-local trivialization with an explicit theta formula; fully displayed.
